duration: Restore is a separate acquisition window; daily checks depend on existing prerequisites
summary: Phase 4: explicitly materialize pinned project dependencies once, then use dispatcher-guarded daily Test/Lint/Coverage without downloads or restoration.
action_notice: Restore is a separate human-approved acquisition stage, directly or through named local Workstation setup with native confirmation. Ordinary agents never Restore. Daily checks never acquire even cached packages; missing runtimes/providers stop.

purpose.p: Keep setup, explicit package acquisition and reproducible daily verification separate.
Installed runtimes and already restored project dependencies are prerequisites. Offline mode alone may still restore cached packages; use the no-restore dispatcher guards.

starting_state.p: Fresh positive Native Verify (all 18 PASS/exit 0) or separately accepted full verification, actual approved profile/source acceptance, required runtimes and reviewed manifests/lockfiles. Keep full FAIL/exit 1 separately visible; no failure-ignore rule. Save work and ensure no competing setup/app/Restore tasks.

steps.title: Approve explicit Dependencies Restore and the samples
steps.where: Workstation setup approval or manual Restore project dependencies task

ol: Approve RestoreTarget Dependencies and the named samples. Manual All includes Python/Java/Go/PowerShell, never Legacy; the agent defaults to the three current application samples.
Review and explicitly confirm package/network acquisition. Runtimes/provider prerequisites must already exist.
The named local agent can invoke each approved Restore task; ordinary agents cannot. Restore is never hidden inside daily Test/F5.

steps.expect: Pinned project environments/dependencies or a truthful unmet prerequisite; no silent installation to make Restore succeed.

rows: Declared project dependencies; standard-library sample needs no external module

body.p: Legacy Java 11/Boot 2.7 is an explicit separate exercise. Do not substitute a runtime, add legacy to All or install missing providers. PowerShell test-module Restore is an additional approved agent scope.

steps.expect: Known restored outputs with runtime/dependency versions distinguished; project-local is not unapproved acquisition permission.

steps.title: Run daily no-restore Test, Lint and Coverage

body.p: Use focused Test/Lint/Coverage Python/Java/Go/PowerShell tasks as needed. The dispatcher prevents uv synchronization/Python download, Maven wrapper/plugin/dependency acquisition and Go toolchain/module downloads. Missing prerequisites mean NOT RUN, not pass.

Direct sample commands belong inside the named sample directory with the required installed/restored environment. Do not copy a bare uv/wrapper command from a general table and allow an implicit download.

steps.expect: Observed results, failures and NOT RUN reported separately. No agent installs/restores to make checks pass.

steps.title: Inspect reports and the approved Testing view
steps.where: VS Code › Testing › Actual report files

head: Sample
Report paths relative to that sample

body.p: Select the locked Python .venv interpreter and correct Java 25/approved Go test tooling. UI discovery is not proof that a pinned-environment check ran. PSScriptAnalyzer/mock/AST checks inspect scripts without executing state-changing entry points.

steps.expect: Actual current reports and truthful runtime/source attribution, not screenshots or stale files presented as live.

expected.p: A separate confirmed Restore stage followed by daily checks that either run against existing prerequisites or explicitly report NOT RUN.

success.p: Observe exit codes/results and current report outputs. Keep runtime/version attribution, failures and skips visible; never equate a list of commands with passing checks.

failures.cause: Setup or explicit Restore prerequisite is absent
failures.fix: Report affected command NOT RUN. Only the named local workflow can return to a separate human-approved acquisition stage; ordinary agents never acquire it.

failures.symptom: Offline command still attempts cached synchronization
failures.cause: Offline mode alone is not a no-restore guarantee
failures.fix: Stop the direct invocation and use the existing dispatcher guards with already restored dependencies; do not weaken or bypass them.

failures.symptom: Old report exists but current command did not run
failures.fix: Label its date/revision/runtime and do not claim it proves the current pinned environment or laptop.

recovery.p: Preserve environments/module/cache trees and source. No broad deletion/reinstall or hidden Restore. Check prerequisites read-only and use [safe recovery](page:operate-recovery).

limitations.p: Daily in-process tests and hosted CI do not establish a live service/container request, enterprise source/profile acceptance or AKS deployment.

say: Restore is an explicit human package decision, not hidden in daily checks.
All excludes the intentional legacy Java exercise.
I show actual results and NOT RUN separately from stale reports.
evidence_gaps: No laptop dependency Restore, current pinned-runtime Test/Lint/Coverage or Testing-view acceptance was observed by this guide.
